concerns.text: The requirement to perform a 'post-hoc power analysis... using the observed effect size' is methodologically unsound. Post-hoc power is a direct monotone function of the p-value and the sample size; it provides no additional information about the study's validity and is widely considered a statistical fallacy. The spec should instead focus on reporting confidence intervals and the Minimum Detectable Effect Size (MDES) for the given sample size.
